# Synthetic DNS for T-141 mailauth fixtures (TEST-NET documentation
# addresses only: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24 — never real infrastructure).
# Fold TXT strings at 255 chars for real zone files.

# kiwi-test.invalid — authorizes only 198.51.100.7
kiwi-test.invalid.              TXT "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.7 -all"
# DKIM selector for auth-dkim-valid.eml (verified by generator round trip)
test._domainkey.kiwi-test.invalid. TXT "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; "
# DMARC: reject, relaxed alignment
_dmarc.kiwi-test.invalid.       TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; aspf=r; adkim=r"

# evil-test.invalid — spoofer infrastructure (passes its own SPF by design)
evil-test.invalid.              TXT "v=spf1 ip4:203.0.113.9 -all"
_dmarc.evil-test.invalid.       TXT "v=DMARC1; p=none"
